name: What is the difference between custom and semi-custom cabinets?
description: Custom cabinets are fully personalized, while semi-custom cabinets use standard sizes with more style options than stock, balancing cost and personalization.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between custom and semi-custom cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom cabinets are built entirely to your specifications, offering unlimited design flexibility in terms of size, shape, material, and finish. Semi-custom cabinets use standard cabinet box sizes but allow for a wider range of door styles, finishes, and accessories than stock cabinets. Custom options are generally more expensive but provide a perfect fit and unique aesthetic, while semi-custom offers a good balance of cost and personalization.
